pdf_options_help.style_help_body:
Body — normal text in the PDF.
Subsection — section heading (\subsection).
Sub-subsection — sub-heading (\subsubsection).

Enable the checkbox to use headings.
pdf_options_help.notes_body:
Adds a dedicated page to the PDF where you can write free-text notes or comments about this characterization.

You will be able to type, format (bold, italic, bullet lists), and preview the text before generating the report.
pdf_options_help.tables_body:
Includes numeric data tables in the PDF with frequency and permittivity (ε′, ε″) values.

Up to 100 evenly-spaced rows are shown.
pdf_options_help.cal_steps_body:
Adds a section showing the S11 chart and value table for each calibration standard measured during the wizard (Open, Short, reference liquids).

Useful for reviewing the calibration quality.
